name: bizplug-beauty
description: The beauty & salons plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book salon services with a stylist. It works from the business's own published profile, covering services, pricing, hours and booking requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Book salon services with a stylist for beauty & salons businesses.
